Container.Name: Frontend-Killer
Container.Overview: Frontend-Killer is a web-based game list manager for emulator frontends. Import, manage, export and scrape game metadata and media across Pegasus, ES-DE, RetroBat, EmuELEC, Lakka and more, with full ScreenScraper integration (auto metadata/media download, CRC32 matching, quota monitoring).
Container.Description: Frontend-Killer manages emulator frontend game lists from a single web UI: multi-format import/export (Pegasus, ES-DE, RetroBat, EmuELEC, Lakka, Skraper), ScreenScraper scraping of metadata and media, media file management, platform merge/migration, background task queue with resume, and Chinese/English/Japanese localization. Runs on an embedded H2 database; all state is kept under /data.
Container.Requires: A ScreenScraper account (free) for scraping, and the path to your ROM library mapped in for import and CRC/file-existence checks.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: game list emulator frontend pegasus es-de retrobat emuelec lakka screenscraper metadata scraper gamelist

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Web interface port. Container listens on 8080.

Config.Name: App Data (db / rules / media / logs)
Config.Description: Persistent storage: H2 database, import/export rules, scraped media, input, output, backups and logs. Map to an appdata share so data survives container updates.

Config.Name: ROM Library
Config.Description: Your ROM library, used as the import source and for CRC/file-existence checks. Point this at the share holding your game files. Optional but recommended.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: Process User ID. Files written to the mapped paths will be owned by this UID (unRAID nobody = 99). Set to 0 to run as root.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Process Group ID. Files written to the mapped paths will be owned by this GID (unRAID users = 100).

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Container timezone, e.g. Asia/Shanghai, Europe/London, America/New_York.

Config.Name: JVM Options
Config.Description: JVM options. Increase -Xmx for very large libraries.

Config.Name: Tomcat Base Dir
Config.Description: Tomcat working directory, kept on the persistent volume.

Config.Name: Static Resource Locations
Config.Description: Extra static resource locations so media under /data can be served over HTTP.
